description: Marie Peeters, Elise Neven and Vincent Lemort publish cleaned experimental data from the first heat-pump campaign on a reversible Organic Rankine Cycle test rig at the University of Liège Thermodynamics Laboratory. The source specifies operation with two of three parallel fixed-speed scroll compressors. The CSV file descriptor identifies steady-state means for this campaign. Results were presented in FlexGeo Deliverable 2.1, where the source places the process schematic. These measurements support evaluation of reversible energy-conversion equipment for Carnot-battery applications. Zenodo provides free access under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is one laboratory rig; a limitation is that test dates, measurement units, operating points and averaging procedures are not detailed in the inspected description. The related TUM resource concerns a different twin-screw machine and site. No measurement values, deliverable body or schematic was downloaded.
